patches.name: Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback
patches.description: Triggers continuous tactile feedback pulses when the backspace key is held down during repeated deletion (with settings toggle and empty text suppression).

patches.name: Enter Key Tasker Event
patches.description: Broadcasts an Intent event to Tasker whenever the Enter or IME action key is pressed on Gboard (with target package, action type, and cursor text).

patches.name: Glide Trail Customization
patches.description: Allows customizing glide typing trail color (interactive HSV Color Wheel & Rainbow RGB), fade speed, thickness, and length.
